question: Do anonymous relational context-to-outcome rules learned from one sealed institutional lane transfer into an independently sealed institutional holdout beyond structure-preserving null worlds and beyond a heterogeneous visual control lane?

evaluation.nullExtremeness: report count of null iterations whose rule accuracy is greater than or equal to observed; do not convert 16 null worlds into a significance claim

candidateTiers.A: holdout support >= 3 sources, holdout lift > 0, specificity lift > 0, and observed holdout accuracy beats every preregistered null iteration
candidateTiers.B: holdout support >= 3 sources, holdout lift > 0, and specificity lift > 0
candidateTiers.C: holdout support >= 3 sources and holdout lift > 0
candidateTiers.exploratory: all other train-derived rules; retained in the frozen packet rather than discarded
